why: Bryant audit: D5 protects nothing the Infinity board doesn't already; it is occupancy-blind energy-shed policy wearing a protection name, abandoning occupied zones on hot coast evenings. Option (b) reframe+gate over (c) delete (still a legit lever on EMPTY zones). Gate is NO-WRITE defer because a setpoint write flips Carrier to manual (the S14 self-lockout). 3 framing-disjoint reviews converged FIX-REQUIRED (rename missed sensor+frontend consumers, defer unwired, kill-latch, non-discriminating live criterion, 8/9 sites UNTESTED). Fix-up added 13 behavioral tests; orchestrator re-ran mutation drills (gate/latch/rename all RED on neuter).
implications: Shipped HVAC-D5-REFRAME-AND-OCCUPANCY-GATE-1 at v5.103.9; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.9.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: On a coast/peak-TOU evening (~18:00-21:00) ura_activity_log shows >=1 row reason=energy_shed_cap_deferred_occupied with details_json any_room_hvac_occupied=1 (occupied zone NOT written) AND >=1 reason=energy_shed_cap_reached (empty zone shed), and ZERO rows reason=runtime_exceeded post-deploy
